summary: Printed zeros (METHODOLOGY decision 6) added for 30 sources: 9,233 zero cells in the Latvian PMLP investor-permit tables (first-time permits 2015-2019 and valid permits 2015-01-01 to 2020-12-31, the PDF editions; the spreadsheet editions 2021-2026 and the 2020 first-time PDF print blanks, not 0, so nothing was added there), 432 for the INZ 2026 residence-decisions report, 926 for the INZ 2024 edition (nearly all cells printed '.', which that edition uses for no decisions), and none for the Australian FOI FA 17/06/00834 (its zeros were already rowed). Every new row is value 0, reading digits, in the same tables, breakdowns, periods, units and status as the existing rows; every table still adds up to its printed totals.
